Beyond the End of the World

You crossed the crumbling stone path and reached a garden no one visits. In an old chest is a note someone left: 'What we call the end is usually just a place no one has crossed yet.' You got 💰 %s silver · 💠 %d sky gems · 📜 %d scrolls.
🦆 Quack! The mother duck brought you a manual scroll
🕳 The faint grass gave way and the ground vanished beneath you
It was grass at the edge of the world that no one had stepped on. You fell through the darkness for a long time and landed on cold stone. You see a great door glowing red and a shadow in a black hat.
🌿 Only this grass feels oddly cool... (someone reborn three times might sense something)
...The chains are already broken. Hear the door breathing at the end of the hall? Go. It's different from the living world over there. Take care.
...So a living person came this far. Want to open the door at the end of the hall? The fare is 💰 %s silver. What you have isn't enough. Come back with it. I'll be waiting here.

💰 %s silver. ...Good. Fare received. The door at the end of the hall is locked with three chains. Three restless spirits wandering this room hold them and won't let go. Go calm them. If you can't, the door won't open. (spirits %d)
...Not yet? The spirits wander the edges of the room. Follow the blue fire. You'll hear crying. Spirits calmed %d / %d.
......The spirits feel lighter. Hear that? The chains breaking at the end of the hall. A hot wind rises from beyond the door.\n\nWalk down the hall and stand before the door.
